caption: The drawing shows a single wooden chair with a brown finish. It has a decorative backrest featuring a symmetrical design with a clover-shaped cutout and two vertical turned spindles in the center. The backrest has a wavy edge along the top and two small finials at the upper corners. The seat of the chair is cushioned and upholstered in a light tan or beige fabric with a faint checkered pattern. The front legs are rounded and turned, matching the shape of the side stretchers and the lower horizontal rails that connect them. The rear legs are straighter but taper toward the bottom. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or details present. The artist’s name, “Archie Thompson,” appears in small text at the lower right.
title: Chair
